key: TAKA: Listen, \PN, I'm starting to think you might have a punching addiction.
en: TAKA: Listen, \PN, I'm starting to think you might have a punching addiction.
ja: タカ: あの\PN　あなたって　パンチ中毒　なんじゃないかって　思えてきました。

key: This is an intervention.
en: This is an intervention.
ja: これは　介入です。

key: We can get you help.
en: We can get you help.
ja: 助けを　求めても　いいんですよ。

key: TAKA: I'm starting to think you might be repressing some seriously destructive impulses.
en: TAKA: I'm starting to think you might be repressing some seriously destructive impulses.
ja: タカ: あなたって　かなり　破壊的な衝動を　抑え込んでるんじゃないかって　思えてきました。

key: ...Anyway, it looks like this hole leads downwards.
en: ...Anyway, it looks like this hole leads downwards.
ja: ……とにかく　この穴　下に　続いてるみたいです。

key: Do we really have to go down there?
en: Do we really have to go down there?
ja: 本当に　あそこへ　降りなきゃ　いけないんですか?

key: The shattered glass hurt \PN!
en: The shattered glass hurt \PN!
ja: 砕けたガラスが\PNを　傷つけた!

key: TAKA: Oh, so that opened a path upwards.
en: TAKA: Oh, so that opened a path upwards.
ja: タカ: おっと　これで　上への道が　開きましたね。

key: There's probably more like this going upwards too.
en: There's probably more like this going upwards too.
ja: たぶん　上に向かっても　同じようなものが　もっと　あるんでしょうね。

key: I don't really get this mechanism too well... so I'll be counting on you.
en: I don't really get this mechanism too well... so I'll be counting on you.
ja: この仕組み　僕には　よく　わからないので……　頼りに　してます。

key: TAKA: I don't think that's gonna be moving anymore.
en: TAKA: I don't think that's gonna be moving anymore.
ja: タカ: あれは　もう　動かないと思います。

key: LAURA: Bennett, I told you--!
en: LAURA: Bennett, I told you--!
ja: ローラ: ベネット　だから言ったでしょう――!

key: Oh, \PN........ My apologies.
en: Oh, \PN........ My apologies.
ja: あら\PN……　失礼しました。

key: ........Perhaps.
en: ........Perhaps.
ja: ……たぶん。

key: Bennett sent you, didn't he?
en: Bennett sent you, didn't he?
ja: ベネットが　あなたを　寄こしたんですね?

key: It's not as if that's a bad thing, but this was supposed to be a family outing........
en: It's not as if that's a bad thing, but this was supposed to be a family outing........
ja: 悪いこと　というわけじゃ　ないんですが　これは　家族の外出の　はずだったんです……

key: And as you can see, the whole family is here, happy and smiling!
en: And as you can see, the whole family is here, happy and smiling!
ja: 見ての通り　家族全員　ここに　いて　幸せそうに　笑ってますよ!

key: LAURA: ........This was a poor attempt at sarcasm,
en: LAURA: ........This was a poor attempt at sarcasm,
ja: ローラ: ……今のは　下手な皮肉の　つもりでした

key: And I haven't a clue what to do.
en: And I haven't a clue what to do.
ja: それに　どうすればいいのか　まったく　わからないんです。

key: We had just arrived here, hoping to have a pleasant afternoon doing our civic Anomaly-hunting duties together in a location that I'd hoped would be at least somewhat clean,
en: We had just arrived here, hoping to have a pleasant afternoon doing our civic Anomaly-hunting duties together in a location that I'd hoped would be at least somewhat clean,
ja: せめて　多少は　きれいな場所であってほしいと願いながら　一緒に　異変狩りの公務を　こなす　楽しい午後を　過ごすつもりで　ここに　着いたばかりだったんですが

key: When Saphira managed to reach her usual intense and mildly over-protective disposition...
en: When Saphira managed to reach her usual intense and mildly over-protective disposition...
ja: サファイラが　いつもの　激しくて　ちょっと過保護な気質を　発揮してしまって……

key: The events are, perhaps, as could be expected.
en: The events are, perhaps, as could be expected.
ja: その後の展開は　まあ　予想通り　というところでしょうか。

key: Charlotte calls her on it,
en: Charlotte calls her on it,
ja: シャルロットが　それを　指摘して

key: Saphira gets defensive retorts,
en: Saphira gets defensive retorts,
ja: サファイラが　むきになって　言い返して

key: Charlotte storms off,
en: Charlotte storms off,
ja: シャルロットが　怒って　出て行って

key: I follow her up the tower to help,
en: I follow her up the tower to help,
ja: 私は　助けようと　塔を　上って　彼女を　追って

key: She wants space,
en: She wants space,
ja: 彼女は　一人に　してほしいと言って

key: So I come back here,
en: So I come back here,
ja: だから　私は　ここに　戻ってきて

key: The way up disappears,
en: The way up disappears,
ja: 上への道は　消えてしまい

key: And Saphira is entirely missing.
en: And Saphira is entirely missing.
ja: サファイラは　完全に　行方不明に　なりました。

key: I panic.
en: I panic.
ja: 私は　パニックに　なります。

key: ........That's the end of story, basically.
en: ........That's the end of story, basically.
ja: ……だいたい　それが　話のてん末です。

key: I've been in various shades of panicking since then.
en: I've been in various shades of panicking since then.
ja: それ以来　いろんな程度の　パニックの中に　いるんです。

key: I assume Saphira's below and I don't know how to help Charlotte, and I can't go chase one without worrying about the other,
en: I assume Saphira's below and I don't know how to help Charlotte, and I can't go chase one without worrying about the other,
ja: サファイラは　たぶん　下に　いると思いますが　シャルロットを　どう助ければ　いいかも　わからず　どちらかを　追いかければ　もう一方が　気になって　しまうんです

key: And the way down looks like it's full of dirt and debris and cobwebs--
en: And the way down looks like it's full of dirt and debris and cobwebs--
ja: それに　下への道は　土と　がれきと　クモの巣だらけに　見えて――

key: I don't know where Saphira went and I don't know how to help Charlotte, and I can't go chase one without worrying about the other,
en: I don't know where Saphira went and I don't know how to help Charlotte, and I can't go chase one without worrying about the other,
ja: サファイラが　どこへ　行ったかも　シャルロットを　どう助ければ　いいかも　わからなくて　どちらかを　追いかければ　もう一方が　気になって　しまうんです

key: And this was only supposed to be a perfectly normal bonding experience--
en: And this was only supposed to be a perfectly normal bonding experience--
ja: それに　これは　ただの　ごく普通の　きずなを　深める体験の　はずだったのに――

key: We haven't had a whole lot of those since our lives started being less actively ruined, you know?
en: We haven't had a whole lot of those since our lives started being less actively ruined, you know?
ja: 私たちの人生が　積極的に　めちゃくちゃに　されなくなってから　そういう機会って　あんまり　なかったんですよ?

key: And now it's all this.
en: And now it's all this.
ja: それが　今や　この有様です。

key: I don't like the fact that Bennett went off and called for help without me agreeing to it,
en: I don't like the fact that Bennett went off and called for help without me agreeing to it,
ja: ベネットが　私の同意なしに　勝手に　助けを　呼びに　行ったのは　気に入らないですし

key: And I like even less the fact that I could........ rather desperately use that help right now.
en: And I like even less the fact that I could........ rather desperately use that help right now.
ja: その助けを　今……　かなり切実に　必要としている事実の方が　もっと　気に入らないんです。

key: Please help me find them.
en: Please help me find them.
ja: どうか　二人を　見つける手伝いを　してください。

key: I........ need-- just a little bit of time.
en: I........ need-- just a little bit of time.
ja: 私……　少しだけ　時間が　必要です。

key: But I'll be right behind you before too long.
en: But I'll be right behind you before too long.
ja: でも　すぐに　あなたの後を　追います。

key: LAURA: Please help me find Charlotte and Saphira.
en: LAURA: Please help me find Charlotte and Saphira.
ja: ローラ: シャルロットと　サファイラを　見つける手伝いを　してください。

key: Charlotte huffed off up the tower,
en: Charlotte huffed off up the tower,
ja: シャルロットは　むっとして　塔を　上っていって

key: Charlotte huffed off up the tower, somehow,
en: Charlotte huffed off up the tower, somehow,
ja: シャルロットは　どういうわけか　むっとして　塔を　上っていって

key: And Saphira probably went down below........
en: And Saphira probably went down below........
ja: サファイラは　たぶん　下の方へ　行ったんだと　思います……

key: The last thing I heard before she disappeared was the sound of glass breaking?
en: The last thing I heard before she disappeared was the sound of glass breaking?
ja: 彼女が　姿を　消す前に　最後に　聞こえたのは　ガラスが　割れる音でした?

key: But I can barely handle going into a place like that under the best of circumstances, let alone like this........
en: But I can barely handle going into a place like that under the best of circumstances, let alone like this........
ja: 最高の状況でも　あんな場所に　入るのは　やっとなのに　こんな状態では　なおさらで……

key: I just........ need some help.
en: I just........ need some help.
ja: 私はただ……　助けが　必要なんです。

key: But I haven't a clue where Saphira could have gone........
en: But I haven't a clue where Saphira could have gone........
ja: でも　サファイラが　どこへ　行ったのか　まったく　見当も　つかなくて……

key: I don't believe she we would leave, but there's nowhere else to go, like a lower level........ is there?
en: I don't believe she we would leave, but there's nowhere else to go, like a lower level........ is there?
ja: 彼女が　立ち去るとは　思えませんが　他に　行き場所――　下の階とか――　あるんでしょうか……?

key: LAURA: You have my renewed gratitude for bringing Charlotte back.
en: LAURA: You have my renewed gratitude for bringing Charlotte back.
ja: ローラ: シャルロットを　連れ戻してくれて　改めて　感謝します。

key: Saphira is still missing somewhere below, but neither of us are quite........ equal to the task of what it would take to retrieve her.
en: Saphira is still missing somewhere below, but neither of us are quite........ equal to the task of what it would take to retrieve her.
ja: サファイラは　まだ　下のどこかで　行方不明ですが　私たちのどちらも　彼女を　連れ戻すのに　必要なことを　こなせる状態では……　ないんです。

key: Thank you for allowing us to impose on you once again.
en: Thank you for allowing us to impose on you once again.
ja: また　ご迷惑を　おかけすることを　許してくれて　ありがとうございます。

key: LAURA: You have my renewed gratitude for bringing Saphira back.
en: LAURA: You have my renewed gratitude for bringing Saphira back.
ja: ローラ: サファイラを　連れ戻してくれて　改めて　感謝します。

key: We've agreed it's probably best if we don't press on Charlotte too much for now.
en: We've agreed it's probably best if we don't press on Charlotte too much for now.
ja: 今は　シャルロットを　あまり　問い詰めない方が　いいだろうと　二人で　話し合いました。

key: I'm sure it wouldn't be a problem for you to go after her, but she clearly needs space from us for a moment.
en: I'm sure it wouldn't be a problem for you to go after her, but she clearly needs space from us for a moment.
ja: あなたが　彼女を　追うのは　問題ないでしょうが　彼女には　明らかに　しばらく　私たちから　距離を　置く時間が　必要なんです。

key: SAPHIRA: Sorry to worry you.
en: SAPHIRA: Sorry to worry you.
ja: サファイラ: 心配　かけて　悪かったわ。

key: I began questioning just what I was even being protective over anymore.
en: I began questioning just what I was even being protective over anymore.
ja: 自分が　一体　何を　守ろうとしてるのか　わからなくなってきて。

key: Didn't have an answer.
en: Didn't have an answer.
ja: 答えは　出なかった。

key: Got mad.
en: Got mad.
ja: 頭に　きた。

key: Punched a mirror.
en: Punched a mirror.
ja: 鏡を　殴った。

key: Fell down there.
en: Fell down there.
ja: そこから　落ちた。

key: Kept falling.
en: Kept falling.
ja: ずっと　落ち続けた。

key: ...Had to punch a mirror to get out.
en: ...Had to punch a mirror to get out.
ja: ……出るには　また　鏡を　殴らなきゃ　いけなかった。

key: LAURA: That sounds........ therapeutic?
en: LAURA: That sounds........ therapeutic?
ja: ローラ: それって……　なんだか　癒やしに　なりそうですね?

key: And also slightly concerning?
en: And also slightly concerning?
ja: それと　ちょっと　心配にも　なりますが?

key: Are you okay?
en: Are you okay?
ja: 大丈夫ですか?

key: SAPHIRA: I'm good. Second one didn't even hurt.
en: SAPHIRA: I'm good. Second one didn't even hurt.
ja: サファイラ: 平気よ。二回目なんて　痛くも　なかったし。

key: LAURA: I meant, like, emotionally?
en: LAURA: I meant, like, emotionally?
ja: ローラ: その、精神的にって　意味なんですが?

key: SAPHIRA: Oh.
en: SAPHIRA: Oh.
ja: サファイラ: ああ。

key: ...Probably.
en: ...Probably.
ja: ……たぶん。

key: SAPHIRA: I've got work to do, but at least for once that work doesn't involve hunting someone down.
en: SAPHIRA: I've got work to do, but at least for once that work doesn't involve hunting someone down.
ja: サファイラ: やることは　あるけど　少なくとも　今回は　誰かを　追い詰める仕事じゃ　ないから。

key: LAURA: You're all right, then?
en: LAURA: You're all right, then?
ja: ローラ: それなら　大丈夫なんですね?

key: CHARLOTTE: Obviously.
en: CHARLOTTE: Obviously.
ja: シャルロット: 当然でしょ。

key: It's not like there's anything up there anyway.
en: It's not like there's anything up there anyway.
ja: どうせ　上には　大したもの　なかったし。

key: Just a bunch of puzzle junk and a big bird.
en: Just a bunch of puzzle junk and a big bird.
ja: パズルのがらくたと　でかい鳥　くらいのもんよ。

key: But our friendly local wrecking ball took care of it, all while listening to me bitch half the way up.
en: But our friendly local wrecking ball took care of it, all while listening to me bitch half the way up.
ja: でも　うちの気さくな破壊王が　道中　半分　あたしの愚痴を　聞かされながらも　全部　片付けてくれたわ。

key: LAURA: It isn't really fair to dismiss your struggles as simple-- er, that........
en: LAURA: It isn't really fair to dismiss your struggles as simple-- er, that........
ja: ローラ: あなたの苦労を　単なる――　えっと　その……　って　片付けるのは　フェアじゃ　ないと思いますよ。

key: CHARLOTTE: What, bitching?
en: CHARLOTTE: What, bitching?
ja: シャルロット: 何よ「愚痴」って?

key: Are you afraid to say "bitching"?
en: Are you afraid to say "bitching"?
ja: 「愚痴」って　言うのが　怖いの?

key: LAURA: Well, no.
en: LAURA: Well, no.
ja: ローラ: いえ　別に。

key: CHARLOTTE: Then say it.
en: CHARLOTTE: Then say it.
ja: シャルロット: だったら　言ってみて。

key: LAURA: It's not a matter of fear; there's just no need to use vulgar language like that........
en: LAURA: It's not a matter of fear; there's just no need to use vulgar language like that........
ja: ローラ: 怖いとかじゃ　なくて　そんな下品な言葉を　使う必要が　ないだけです……

key: CHARLOTTE: You can't say it.
en: CHARLOTTE: You can't say it.
ja: シャルロット: つまり　言えないんでしょ。

key: LAURA: I can. I'm just choosing not to.
en: LAURA: I can. I'm just choosing not to.
ja: ローラ: 言えますとも。ただ　言わないと　決めているだけです。

key: Especially since your concerns are more than valid, and writing them off so negatively isn't healthy.
en: Especially since your concerns are more than valid, and writing them off so negatively isn't healthy.
ja: 特に　あなたの不満は　十分に　正当なものですから　そんなに　否定的に　片付けてしまうのは　健全じゃ　ありません。

key: CHARLOTTE: Fine. A different context.
en: CHARLOTTE: Fine. A different context.
ja: シャルロット: わかった。じゃあ　別の文脈で。

key: Say "this tower is bitchin'."
en: Say "this tower is bitchin'."
ja: 「この塔　イケてるわね」って　言ってみて。

key: That's a positive thing, right? Go ahead.
en: That's a positive thing, right? Go ahead.
ja: それって　ポジティブな意味でしょ? さあ。

key: LAURA: The tower is-- perfectly adequate?
en: LAURA: The tower is-- perfectly adequate?
ja: ローラ: この塔は――　実に　申し分ないですね?

key: LAURA: I--
en: LAURA: I--
ja: ローラ: 私――

key: This tower is certainly rather bitching, wouldn't you agree?
en: This tower is certainly rather bitching, wouldn't you agree?
ja: この塔は　確かに　なかなか　イケてると　思いませんか?

key: CHARLOTTE: Snrk.
en: CHARLOTTE: Snrk.
ja: シャルロット: ぷっ。

key: LAURA: Excuse me?
en: LAURA: Excuse me?
ja: ローラ: 何か　言いました?

key: I said it, did I not?!
en: I said it, did I not?!
ja: 言ったでしょう?!

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, with all the grace of a half-dead boomer.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, with all the grace of a half-dead boomer.
ja: シャルロット: ええ　半分死にかけたおばさんみたいな　優雅さでね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Anyway, I'm fine.
en: CHARLOTTE: Anyway, I'm fine.
ja: シャルロット: とにかく　あたしは　大丈夫。

key: I think I'm ready to move on.
en: I think I'm ready to move on.
ja: もう　次に　進む準備は　できたと思う。

key: LAURA: Okay, so now that \PN has shown up and done literally all of our jobs for us,
en: LAURA: Okay, so now that \PN has shown up and done literally all of our jobs for us,
ja: ローラ: さて\PNが　来て　私たちの仕事を　文字通り　全部　やってくれた今

key: Can we maybe sit down and talk about things like mature and reasonable adults?
en: Can we maybe sit down and talk about things like mature and reasonable adults?
ja: 座って　大人らしく　分別のある大人同士として　話し合えないでしょうか?

key: CHARLOTTE: I dunno, "adults" might be a tall ask.
en: CHARLOTTE: I dunno, "adults" might be a tall ask.
ja: シャルロット: どうかな「大人」って　言うのは　ちょっと　ハードル高いかも。

key: You sure Saphira is old enough for that yet?
en: You sure Saphira is old enough for that yet?
ja: サファイラが　その年齢に　達してるか　本当に　確か?

key: SAPHIRA: Excuse you.
en: SAPHIRA: Excuse you.
ja: サファイラ: 何ですって。

key: CHARLOTTE: Gottem.
en: CHARLOTTE: Gottem.
ja: シャルロット: 引っかかったわね。

key: LAURA: At least you two are joking again........
en: LAURA: At least you two are joking again........
ja: ローラ: 少なくとも　二人とも　また　冗談を　言い合えるように　なったんですね……

key: SAPHIRA: It shouldn't be your job to peacemake like this.
en: SAPHIRA: It shouldn't be your job to peacemake like this.
ja: サファイラ: こうやって　仲裁するのは　姉さんの仕事じゃ　ないはずよ。

key: I've been a poor excuse for an eldest sister.
en: I've been a poor excuse for an eldest sister.
ja: あたしは　長女として　情けなかった。

key: LAURA: No, that's part of your problem.
en: LAURA: No, that's part of your problem.
ja: ローラ: いいえ　それこそが　あなたの問題の一部なんです。

key: You keep placing that burden on yourself even when there's no longer any need to.
en: You keep placing that burden on yourself even when there's no longer any need to.
ja: もう　その必要が　ないのに　あなたは　その重荷を　自分に　背負わせ続けています。

key: Let us take care of you for a change.
en: Let us take care of you for a change.
ja: たまには　私たちに　あなたの面倒を　見させてください。

key: SAPHIRA: That feels wrong.
en: SAPHIRA: That feels wrong.
ja: サファイラ: それって　なんか　間違ってる気がする。

key: But I don't know what's right, so I'll defer to your judgment.
en: But I don't know what's right, so I'll defer to your judgment.
ja: でも　何が　正しいのか　わからないから　姉さんの判断に　従うわ。

key: LAURA: And Charlotte, it would probably help if you--
en: LAURA: And Charlotte, it would probably help if you--
ja: ローラ: それと　シャルロット　あなたも　その――

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, yeah, stop throwing hissy-fits, something something maturity, something friendship and love.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, yeah, stop throwing hissy-fits, something something maturity, something friendship and love.
ja: シャルロット: はいはい　ヒステリー起こすの　やめろとか　うんぬん　成熟しろとか　うんぬん　友情と愛が　どうとか。

key: LAURA: I was going to say, it would probably help for you to stop trying to deflect from genuine emotional conversations with sarcasm.
en: LAURA: I was going to say, it would probably help for you to stop trying to deflect from genuine emotional conversations with sarcasm.
ja: ローラ: 私が　言いたかったのは　あなたが　本気の感情的な会話から　皮肉で　逃げるのを　やめてくれると　助かるということです。

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Yeah, but that's no fun.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Yeah, but that's no fun.
ja: シャルロット: ……そうだけど　それじゃ　つまんないでしょ。

key: SAPHIRA: Neither was any of this.
en: SAPHIRA: Neither was any of this.
ja: サファイラ: 今回の　これも　全然　楽しくなかったけどね。

key: CHARLOTTE: I dunno; I had a decent time up there?
en: CHARLOTTE: I dunno; I had a decent time up there?
ja: シャルロット: どうかな　あそこでの時間　結構　悪くなかったし?

key: LAURA: Charlotte.
en: LAURA: Charlotte.
ja: ローラ: シャルロット。

key: CHARLOTTE: Fine, fine, fine, fine, fine.
en: CHARLOTTE: Fine, fine, fine, fine, fine.
ja: シャルロット: はいはい　わかった　わかった　わかった。

key: I hereby swear to be the least sarcastic person on this planet,
en: I hereby swear to be the least sarcastic person on this planet,
ja: ここに　誓うわ　この地球上で　一番　皮肉じゃない人間に　なるって

key: For three minutes,
en: For three minutes,
ja: 3分間だけ

key: If you're lucky.
en: If you're lucky.
